build_dataloader_from_args: build a dataloader from DataArgs for tokenized sequence data with optional async prefetching
init_dataloader_state_from_args: initialize a PrefetchState from DataArgs for distributed training with rank and world size
tokenize_iterator: tokenize an iterator of text content pairs into tokens with BOS and EOS support
pack_tokens_into_chunks: pack token sequences into fixed-size chunks with sliding window views for training
batch_and_shuffle_prefetched_sequences: batch and shuffle prefetched token sequences using reservoir sampling to reduce correlation
